strategy.description: Your M.Sc. AI and Claude Code experience is a rare differentiator. strengths.detail: Async task queues and caching in 6 jobs. Hassan's Redis + Celery production experience directly matches Cara Care, Lumenaza, Sunday Natural, suena energy, Engelhart, The Exploration Company stack requirements.

strengths.name: Distributed Systems & Kafka
strengths.detail: Kafka in 5 jobs (GALVANY, Flix, exmox, Parloa, Sunday Natural). Hassan's event-driven architecture and microservices experience aligns with high-throughput production systems.

strengths.detail: Explicitly required in 8+ roles. Hassan's API gateway, rate limiting, and microservices experience at IDEX directly demonstrates this capability. Key for ARX Robotics, lemon.markets, Ebury, and Scope Ratings.

strengths.detail: Differentiator for 7 AI-focused roles: Audatic (speech enhancement AI, TensorFlow), Mindpeak (digital pathology ML), Jobgether (AI/ML developer tools), Cresta (AI-powered CDP), Parloa (conversational AI), The Exploration Company (LangChain), Venture Up (MLflow/SageMaker). weaknesses.detail: Roles like Venture Up (MLflow/SageMaker), Mindpeak (ML model serving), EnopAI (real-time optimization) require production ML deployment experience. Hassan has M.Sc. AI but limited production ML engineering.

weaknesses.detail: FinTech roles (lemon.markets, Engelhart, Ebury, Scope Ratings) value domain expertise. Hassan has IDEX payment processing experience but lacks deep brokerage/trading knowledge. Can be positioned as transferable.
